# Vendored libraries

Two MIT-licensed files, shipped unmodified, so SHITTOWN runs offline with no
package manager or build step.

- `three.min.js` — three.js r128 (2021), MIT. https://threejs.org
- `cannon.min.js` — cannon.js 0.6.2, MIT. https://github.com/schteppe/cannon.js

No other third-party runtime code is used. Every texture, character, prop,
sound, and music note is generated by `assets/js/util.js`, `assets/js/world.js`,
and `assets/js/audio.js`.
